## Validation

## Review notes

- [ ] This pull request is focused on one change.
- [ ] I updated tests or explained why tests are not needed.
- [ ] I updated documentation or explained why it is not needed.
- [ ] I called out any change to dependencies, command planning, host access, network access, workflows, or release behavior.
- [ ] I included a screenshot or recording for a terminal interface change, when useful.
